title: A Mini-Batch Counterexample to Last-Iterate Convergence in Definable Optimization
summary: We give a counterexample to the convergence conjecture in Remark 12 of [Bolte & Pauwels, 2021] for mini-batch stochastic approximation with definable potentials. The construction uses two convex piecewise-affine, hence semialgebraic, summands on $\mathbb{R}$. We choose a deterministic nonincreasing block stepsize sequence satisfying $α_k = o(1/\log k)$ and an admissible minimum-norm selection from each aggregate batch field.
